# Test support for bolero mod edit -toolchain to set toolchain to use

env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=local
env BOLERO_MODULE=on

! grep toolchain go.mod
bolero mod edit -toolchain=go1.9
grep 'toolchain go1.9' go.mod

bolero mod edit -toolchain=default
grep 'toolchain default' go.mod

bolero mod edit -toolchain=none
! grep toolchain go.mod

-- go.mod --
module m
go 1.8
